name: Mere Touch Effect
fact: Merely touching an object results in an increase in perceived ownership of that object.
boundary: This effect applies to both non-owners (buyers) and legal owners (sellers) and influences the valuation of the object.

provenance.title: The Effect of Mere Touch on Perceived Ownership
provenance.quote_or_locus: This research finds that merely touching an object results in an increase in perceived ownership of that object
